title: Agentic AI Foundations for Product Builders

modules.title: AI Foundations: Understand and Structure User Requests
modules.description: Connect generative AI foundations to product decisions: prompts, context, structured responses, and a tested request-understanding workflow. Four lessons plus a guided build; allow 4–6 hours.

topics.title: What does “help me order dinner” mean?
What the model knows—and what it needs
Turn a conversation into usable fields
Build, inspect, and improve the first loop

modules.title: Retrieval: Ground Recommendations in Reliable Information
modules.description: Retrieve useful menu evidence, preserve its context, filter real constraints, and explain recommendations with sources.

topics.title: Choose the right source for each claim
Keep meaning intact when you retrieve
Filter constraints before ranking preferences
Build a shortlist with inspectable evidence

modules.title: Agent Workflows: Connect Tools and Manage State
modules.description: Define tool contracts, inspect state transitions, recover from failures, and understand when frameworks or multiple agents help.

topics.title: Give each tool a clear contract
Track what happened and what comes next
Recover without repeating costly actions
Choose frameworks and protocols deliberately

modules.title: Model Adaptation: Choose Prompts, Retrieval, or Fine-Tuning
modules.description: Diagnose failures before choosing an intervention, understand LoRA and QLoRA, and compare local-model tradeoffs.

topics.title: Choose the fix that matches the failure
Build examples that teach the intended behavior
Understand what LoRA and QLoRA change
Compare a local model with your baseline

modules.title: Evaluation: Measure Quality and Diagnose Failures
modules.description: Build a small test set, use appropriate graders, inspect traces, and compare changes without hiding critical failures.

topics.title: Turn user promises into test cases
Use code, rubrics, and model judges appropriately
Find the first wrong step in a trace
Decide whether an improvement is ready to ship

modules.title: Safety and Release: Protect Users and Require Approval
modules.description: Keep untrusted content separate from authority, minimize sensitive data, enforce approval, and demonstrate the complete prototype honestly.

topics.title: Treat retrieved text as evidence, not instructions
Give the assistant only the data and access it needs
Make approval specific, current, and enforceable
Demonstrate the prototype and plan a responsible release

subtitle: Six practical modules: understand requests, ground recommendations, connect tools, adapt models, evaluate behavior, and release safely.
